text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I pickled way too much again. And 
here I thought I was being careful...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh? Does that mean it's all-you-can-eat?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still~, I feel bad, Tran-san. You're 
always eating my food, after all...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, it's totally the best~. It's just 
perfect for taking a break from work. 
Especially this saltiness!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on. For now, let's sip some 
tea and munch on some snacks.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, in that case, I'll brew us some 
super tasty tea~.

Transcend relaxed her body by having a 
leisurely cup of tea with Wonder Acute.
